categories.question: The hotel serves breakfast from four hot trays. Which plate would you order again?

outcomes.name: Masala dosa
outcomes.description: thin golden dosa rolled around turmeric potatoes

outcomes.name: Idli

outcomes.name: Aloo paratha
outcomes.description: layered pan-fried potato flatbread with butter

outcomes.name: Poha
outcomes.description: yellow flattened rice with peanuts and curry leaves

categories.question: The host passes the breakfast dishes around. What do you put on your plate first?

outcomes.name: Menemen
outcomes.description: eggs scrambled with tomatoes and peppers in a metal pan

outcomes.name: Börek
outcomes.description: spiral coil of flaky Turkish pastry

outcomes.name: Kaymak and honey
outcomes.description: small dish of clotted cream drizzled with golden honey

categories.question: You smell breakfast cooking in the courtyard. What are you most curious to taste?

outcomes.name: Gallo pinto
outcomes.description: dark beans and seasoned rice flecked with sweet peppers

outcomes.name: Pupusa
outcomes.description: two thick griddled stuffed corn cakes with a little curtido

outcomes.name: Desayuno chapín
outcomes.description: Guatemalan breakfast plate with beans plantain and eggs

outcomes.name: Baleada
outcomes.description: folded flour tortilla with refried beans and crumbled cheese

categories.question: Your toast is warm and there is time to try one jar. Which lid do you open?

outcomes.name: Lemon curd

outcomes.name: Fig jam

outcomes.name: Pistachio butter
